|errata_history=Documented image occurrences follow the preserved sources below. Repository timestamps identify copies, the archive capture supplies a known-by bound, and the December 2022 sheet gives a month edition. None independently establishes an unknown first-publication day. The relative first-publication days of the December full face and partial are not established.
* '''Original full face''' ([[There Is Another]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable import, 8 July 2018]; no errata mark.
* '''Errata, earlier partial''' ([[There Is Another (Errata)]]): present in the complete official PDF archived 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z; no errata mark. It retains the earlier game text and the Reflections III icon. <ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-3-5-extract.pdf|Official Set 9 PDF archived 5 October 2021]], original page 5 (extract page 3).</ref>
* '''Errata 2, intermediate full face''' ([[There Is Another (Errata 2)]]): [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/thereisanother.png source PNG] authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z; exact decoded RGB and dimensions match the selected preserved July full image. No errata mark; earlier game text retained.
* '''Errata 3, current full face''' ([[There Is Another (Errata 3)]]): [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/thereisanother.png source PNG] authored and committed 2022-12-12T00:40:28Z; exact decoded RGB and dimensions match the current Wiki GIF. Prints E1. Compared with the earlier text, the Death Star II Luke loss is removed, the final Take Your Father's Place loss modifier is replaced by the Leia-crossing modifier and no Force loss to the opponent's Objective, and the Reflections III icon is absent.
* '''Errata 4, current-text partial''' ([[There Is Another (Errata 4)]]): December 2022 sheet edition; prints E1 and the current game text. <ref>[[:File:PC-Errata-December-2022.pdf|Official December 2022 errata sheet]], page 3.</ref> The October 2023 PDF repeats the exact same JPEG and display PNG/pixels; its differently compressed transparency-mask stream does not create another version. <ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-October-2023.pdf|Official Set 9 sheet, October 2023 edition]], page 5.</ref>
The numbering inserts the documented older partial before the July full-face copy and preserves the existing ordering of the two full faces. The December partial is catalogued alongside its corresponding full face; the unknown first days within that month are not claimed. Actual printed marks are recorded separately from image ordinals in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:VD-L-thereisanother-2021-December-2022-partial-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and current-text partials; source artwork windows remain omitted.]]
|notes=* The unique title, destiny 0, Defensive Shield type bar, host-card lore and game text are printed on the partial. This is a Virtual Set D card despite appearing in the Set 9 sheet; the printed D mark and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/SetDType.html official Set D card list] support that membership. Unprinted rarity PM follows that list.
* The lore describes the host character; this Defensive Shield is not assigned character gender, characteristics, landspeed or a Leia persona. Defensive Shields play rather than deploy ([[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook 2023]], page 80); virtual slips replace covered information (page 101). No hidden art-edge copyright is transcribed from the partial.
